input.subject: Your flight BW 484 has been cancelled
input.text:
Dear customer,

We regret that flight BW 484 from Port of Spain to New York on 24 October 2026 has been cancelled.

You may choose a free rebooking, or request a full refund of US$412.80 to your original form of payment by 20 November 2026 at caribbean-airlines.example/refund.

We apologise for the inconvenience.
